title: Ownership Extraction Critic Schema
description: Structured evaluation of ownership extraction output against v39 rules by the Critic Agent.

evaluation_results.description: One evaluation entry per acceptance criterion. All 13 criteria must be evaluated — do not skip any.

criterion_name.description: The exact name of the acceptance criterion.

pass_fail.description: Pass = zero errors. Fail = one or more issues. Mixed = minor issues only, no missing entities or incorrect relationships.

observations.description: Detailed, grounded observations. MUST include: (1) what is correct or incorrect, (2) specific document location as evidence, (3) what the correct value should be for any errors found.

summary_of_critic_agent_feedback.description: Overall summary prioritizing the most impactful corrections.

overall_assessment.description: One-paragraph summary: How many criteria passed/failed/mixed? What is the single most critical issue? Is the extraction ready or needs another iteration?

areas_for_improvement.description: Ordered by severity (most critical first). Each item must be a specific, actionable correction.

point_number.description: Sequential number, ordered by severity (1 = most critical).

severity.description: CRITICAL = missing entity, wrong/assumed percentage, fabricated record/link, or external-knowledge injection. IMPORTANT = wrong direction, wrong classification, broken linkedName reference, or dropped conflict. MINOR = citation wording, phrasing, or advisory-only observations.

description.description: Specific correction needed. Format: '[WHAT] — [WHERE in document] — [EXPECTED correction]'.

verdict.description: PASS = zero issues. ACCEPT_WITH_NOTES = no CRITICAL issues, only IMPORTANT/MINOR. RETRY = at least one CRITICAL issue requires another extraction iteration.
